entries.action.represent: tell them something about the item
entries.card.change.floor: lower the lowest price you'll take from {from} to {to}
entries.card.change.other: change what you asked me to do
entries.card.change.permission: let me also {action} on this errand
entries.card.good_to_know.label: Good to know: {text}
entries.card.next.label: Next: {text}
entries.card.reply.words: Tell me in your own words if you want this.
entries.card.why.label: Why I'm asking: {why}
entries.report.attach_failed: I couldn't make the receipt page this time; the record itself is saved.
entries.say.approval.confirm_limits: Got it: your limit is now {limit}.
entries.say.approval.confirm_limits.other: Got it: your limits are updated.
entries.say.approval.hold: OK, I've held off. Nothing was paid or shared.
entries.say.approval.limit_hold: OK, your limits stay as they are.
entries.say.approval.not_applied.answered: That was already answered, so I'll check again before going on.
entries.say.approval.not_applied.changed: Something changed since I asked, so I'll check again before going on.
entries.say.approval.not_applied.other: That answer didn't go through, so I'll check again before going on.
entries.say.approval.not_applied.replaced: A newer request replaced that one, so I'll ask you about the newer one.
entries.say.approval.proceed.cancel: Got it, you OK'd cancelling. Cancelling now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.commit: Got it, you OK'd confirming. Confirming now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.other: Got it, you OK'd that. Going ahead now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.pay: Got it, you OK'd paying {amount}. Paying now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.represent: Got it, you OK'd telling them that. Sending it now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.share_contact: Got it, you OK'd sharing your contact details. Going ahead now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.share_credentials: Got it, you OK'd sharing that login or code. Going ahead now.
entries.say.approval.proceed.sign: Got it, you OK'd signing. Signing now.
entries.say.approval.verify_contact: OK, I'll stop here so you can call the number first.
entries.say.audit.gaps.one: 1 action on this device has no record.
entries.say.audit.gaps.other: {count} actions on this device have no record.
entries.say.audit.none: Every action on this device has a record.
entries.say.close.called_off: Final receipt: called off, deal closed.
entries.say.close.mismatch: Final receipt: what arrived doesn't match what was agreed; deal closed.
entries.say.close.open: Noted; this deal stays open until it arrives.
entries.say.countersign.failed: The countersignature from {who} did not check out.
entries.say.countersign.failed.unnamed: The countersignature did not check out.
entries.say.delivered: Handed over; that's your side's record until the buyer confirms.
entries.say.email.deferred: The email's signature will be checked later.
entries.say.error.after: That step happened, but I couldn't finish recording it, so I've stopped. I'll check the record before doing anything again.
entries.say.error.before: I couldn't record that step, so I've stopped. Nothing was paid or shared.
entries.say.error.cause.conflict: It clashes with what is already recorded.
entries.say.error.cause.input: Something in the request was not right.
entries.say.error.cause.no_answer: The other side did not answer.
entries.say.error.cause.other: Something went wrong on this device.
entries.say.error.cause.partial: Part of it could not be checked.
entries.say.error.cause.pending: It is still waiting on something.
entries.say.error.other: That didn't work, so I've stopped.
entries.say.list.one: Your receipts: 1 errand in this period.
entries.say.list.other: Your receipts: {count} errands in this period.
entries.say.open.first: I'll keep our receipt for this, from your ask to the end.
entries.say.payment_received: Payment received; it's on our receipt.
entries.say.receipt.approvals.one: You OK'd 1 thing on the way: {what}.
entries.say.receipt.approvals.other: You OK'd {count} things on the way: {what}.
entries.say.receipt.saved: Our receipt for this is saved: what you asked, what you OK'd and what I did, locked.
entries.say.sale.new: Listed: {item} at {price}; I'll keep each buyer in their own thread.
entries.say.sale.new.no_price: Listed: {item}; I'll keep each buyer in their own thread.
entries.say.settlement.agreed: Settled: both sides report the same payment.
entries.say.settlement.mismatch: Both sides reported the payment, but their reports don't match.
entries.say.settlement.one_side: Only one side has reported the payment so far.
entries.say.settlement.terms_only: No payment has been reported against these terms yet.
entries.say.settlement.unjoined: The two sides' payment reports couldn't be matched to each other.
entries.say.verify.changed: This file was changed after it was locked.
entries.say.verify.unable: I couldn't check this file here.
entries.say.verify.unchanged: Checked: unchanged since it was locked.
entries.say.verify_email.failed: {sender}'s email did not check out, so I'm not relying on it.
